title: Identify charter schools in California that are locally funded and have a K
question: Identify charter schools in California that are locally funded and have a K-12 enrollment at least 50 students greater than their Ages 5-17 enrollment. Among these, return only those that rank in the top 3 within their county based on the eligible free or reduced price meal rate for K-12. For each qualifying school, provide its name, city, charter number, and the calculated FRPM rate.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s.XCL_041 AS school_id,
        s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
        s.XCL_050 AS city,
        s.XCL_064 AS charter_number,
        s.XCL_045 AS county,
        CAST(f.XCL_020 AS REAL) / f.XCL_019 AS frpm_rate
    FROM schools s
    INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
    WHERE s.XCL_063 = 1
      AND s.XCL_065 = 'Locally funded'
      AND f.XCL_019 - f.XCL_024 >= 50
),
ranked_schools AS (
    SELECT
        es.school_id,
        es.school_name,
        es.city,
        es.charter_number,
        es.county,
        es.frpm_rate,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY es.county ORDER BY es.frpm_rate DESC) AS county_rank
    FROM eligible_schools es
)
SELECT
    rs.school_name,
    rs.city,
    rs.charter_number,
    rs.frpm_rate
FROM ranked_schools rs
WHERE rs.county_rank <= 3

WITH eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s.XCL_041 AS school_id,
        s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
        s.XCL_050 AS city,
        s.XCL_064 AS charter_number,
        s.XCL_045 AS county,
        CAST(f.XCL_020 AS REAL) / f.XCL_019 AS frpm_rate
    FROM schools s
    INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
    WHERE s.XCL_063 = 1
      AND s.XCL_065 = 'Locally funded'
      AND f.XCL_019 - f.XCL_024 >= 50
),
ranked_schools AS (
    SELECT
        es.school_id,
        es.school_name,
        es.city,
        es.charter_number,
        es.county,
        es.frpm_rate,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY es.county ORDER BY es.frpm_rate DESC) AS county_rank
    FROM eligible_schools es
)
SELECT
    rs.school_name,
    rs.city,
    rs.charter_number,
    rs.frpm_rate
FROM ranked_schools rs
WHERE rs.county_rank <= 3
